title: Practice pad and Lovett's even hands
summary: Lovett practises on a rubber pad and says he plays evenly with both hands.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: What do you do for practice, Baby, because I know hopefully we get it working but sometimes we're not working.
Well I use a practice pad.
I can do anything I want because your sticks automatically bounce off this rubber, you understand.
You can make anything you want to.
Well sometime I want you to show me that left hand of yours, that very brilliant left hand of yours.
I've watched it for years, mind you, but just the two of us, we'll get together.
Well you see Art, I'm an even-handed drummer. What I make with my right I make with my left and I can show you that.
Maybe when we finish this interview.
